scientific_integrity: All statements concern the precisely defined matroid-flat poset. Canonical rank-three Hintikka types and explicit Venn-cell inequalities are supplied; numerical tests are auxiliary.
scientific_limitations: Pure inclusion language and uniform matroids of positive rank only; rank three only. The all-size conclusion rests on the four-cell integer-case lemma, not a finite sweep. Potential unindexed historical overlap; no independent scientific audit.
title: Eleven rank-three theories of uniform-matroid flat lattices
